_real_world.variant_scope: T56-A-425 as fitted to C-2A Greyhound (twin-engine installation, 4,600 shp each)

_provenance.modeling_note: Same schema limitation and conversion approach as CSG_US_T56-A-427A (aircraft/modules/engines/csg/us/t56_a_427a.json): the loader's Engine block is thrust-in-newtons shaped with no shaft-horsepower field, so mil_thrust_n/ab_thrust_n is an engineering_estimate equivalent static thrust from the sourced 4,600 shp rating via the same T[N]~=4.0*shp proxy factor, not a real turboprop performance figure. ab_thrust_n=mil_thrust_n (no afterburner); bypass_ratio=0.0 placeholder (not applicable to a turboprop).

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: 4,600 shp sourced (A, OOB page); converted via T[N]=4.0*shp proxy factor since the loader has no shp field. Not a real thrust figure

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: set equal to mil_thrust_n; turboprop has no afterburner stage

engine.sfc_mil.note: generic T56-family max-power SFC (0.4690 lb/(hp.h), Wikipedia Allison T56 performance table); same-family proxy, no -425-specific SFC found

engine.sfc_ab.note: same generic T56-family SFC figure as sfc_mil

engine.bypass_ratio.note: 0.0 placeholder; not a meaningful concept for a turboprop
